subject.title: [Telegram] 机器人头像更改后无法同步到 Telegram 客户端

question: Should OpenClaw mutate the public Telegram bot profile photo from Web UI assistant-avatar changes, and if so should it be an explicit action, an opt-in setting, or unsupported?
rationale: This crosses from local/browser identity rendering into external Telegram account mutation with bot-token authority, so automation should not choose the consent, security, or source-of-truth boundary.

options.title: Explicit opt-in sync action
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned action/control that requires operator intent, uses the bot profile-photo API, reports failures, and includes live Telegram proof.

options.title: Manual Telegram ownership
options.body: Keep Web UI avatars local to OpenClaw and document that bot profile photos are managed in Telegram/BotFather.

options.title: Automatic bidirectional sync
options.body: Automatically propagate avatar changes both ways, accepting higher surprise, conflict-resolution, and privacy risk.

recommendation.title: Explicit opt-in sync action
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned action/control that requires operator intent, uses the bot profile-photo API, reports failures, and includes live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to current avatar identity code/docs and is the clearest routing owner for the product/security boundary decision.
